actions.action: Place plant in bright shade or morning sun for 1-2 hours (days 1-3), then move it back
Add about an hour of morning sun per day or move it to filtered light (days 4-7)
Gradually increase to a few hours of direct sun from week 2, avoiding harsh afternoon sun
If hanging, move it gradually closer to the sun over time
Watch for sunburn signs (red/bronze/brown leaves, crispy or white spots)
If sunburn appears, move it back to more shade
If leaves look stretched, pale or leggy, give more light
Check soil and water deeply only when completely dry
Make sure the pot drains well
Move it away from cold or frost when needed
Check the hanging pot regularly for dryness
Relocate the fuchsia or succulent to separate spots suited to each
